units.source_scale_reason: One fixed anatomical scale per original source matches the existing approximately 234px helmet-crest-to-sole body. Pelvis and planted soles provide registration; no per-pose resizing or deformation.

visual_review.notes: Eight clips reviewed at native Godot battle scale: articulated grip idle, two-handed muzzle shove, aimed shot and recoil, stagger/guard, physical support signal, grounded corpse and reciprocal walk. Foreground-leg corrections preserve side ownership. Matching original lowered-weapon recovery replaces two oversized ranged proposals; no duplicates within any clip. All nine masters and rejected proposals retained.
